## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused, and related issues are linked.
- [ ] Tests are added or updated where it makes sense.
- [ ] Documentation is updated for any user-facing change.
- [ ] Breaking changes are described, with migration steps.
- [ ] I've reviewed and understand every change, including any AI-generated code.
